content: Runapita supaycunata Jesus gargungan
Tsaynö aywaraycarnam Galilea gochapa wac-tsimpan “Gerasa” ningan marcaman päsariyargan.
Tsaychö Jesus büquipita yarpuriptinnam supay löcuyätsingan juc runa caru panteonpita yargascamur cörrillapa shamurgan.
Tsay runaga panteoncunachö täcogmi cargan. Supaycunapa munayninchö captin mana ni pipis tsarayta puëdiyänätsu ni cadinacunawan pancarninpis.
Atsca cuti chaquipita maquipita runacuna pancayaptinpis supayyog car tsay runaga cadinatapis ichic ichicllaman rachir ushacätseg. Manam ni pipis puëdiyänätsu ni imanaytapis.
Tsay runaga pagasnin junagnin purinä gayarar gagacunapapis panteoncunapapis rumicunawan tacacurnin.
Tsaynam Jesusta ricasquir tsay runa cörrillapa aywargan Jesuspa ñöpanman gonguricog. Tsaynö payman aywaptinnam Jesus nirgan: “¡Gam supay, cay runapita yarguy!” nir.

Niptinnam ñöpanman gonguricuycur mantsarir supayyog runa gayarargan: “Poderösu Tayta Diospa tsurin Jesus, ¿imatatä munanqui nogacunawan? ¡Gamta rugacümi Tayta Dios raycur! ¡Ama cay runapita gargamarnï condenaycamaytsu!” nir.
Tsaynam supayta Jesus tapurgan: “¿Imatä jutiqui?” nir. Niptinnam supay nirgan: “Nogapa jutëga Legionmi.
Legion niyäman pasaypa atscag cayaptïmi” nir.
Tsaynö nisquirmi Jesusta rugacurgan: “Ama nogacunata caru marcacunamanga gargaycayämaytsu” nirnin.
Tsay caycäyangan washa lädun jircan niragchömi atsca cuchicuna micuycäyargan.
Tsaynam supaycuna Jesusta yapay rugar niyargan: “Tagaychö caycag cuchicunallaman cachaycayämay yaycucuycuyänäpä” nir.

Tsaychö cuchicunaman aywayänanpä Jesus niptinnam runapita yargurir ishcay waranganö (2,000) cuchicunaman yaycucuycuyargan. Tsaynam cuchicunaga acataycachaycar gochaman jegarpäriyargan. Tsaychömi chipyaypa shengacar wanuyargan.
Tsayta ricaycur cuchi mitsegcunaga geshpir aywacuyargan marcapam ricayangancunata willacuyänanpä. Tsay willacuyaptinnam runacunaga marcapita shayämurgan: “Mä imash päsaycushga” nirnin.
Jesus caycanganman chaycurnam ricayargan supay löcuyätsingan runa trocapäcushga shumag fisyunchöna jamaraycagta. Tsayta ricaycur runacunaga pasaypam mantsariyargan.
Marcapita chag runacunata willayargan supayyog runata Jesus allïtsingantam y gochaman cuchicuna jegayangantam.
Tsaynam runacuna Jesusta rugar niyargan tsay marcapita jucläpa aywacunanpä.
Tsaynam Jesus büquiman yarcuraycaptinna alliyag runa rugar nirgan: “Taytay, gamwan aywacuytam noga munä. Pushacallämay” nirnin.
Tsaynö niptinnam Jesus nirgan: “Nogawan aywacunayquipa rantinga wayiquipa cutir marca mayiquicunata willay gamta cuyapäshurniqui Tayta Dios allïtsishungayquita” nir.

Tsaynam runa marcanman cutiycur Decapolis provinciapa maytsay marcancunapa purirgan Jesus cuyapar paypä ruranganta willacurnin. Tsay willacunganta wiyarnin runacunaga imanömi espantacur parlayargan supay löcuyätsinganpita Jesus allïtsinganta.
Jairupa tsurinta y yawar apaywan geshyacog warmita Jesus allïtsingan
Tsaypita Jesus büquiwan gocha wac-tsimpanman chärinanpäga pasaypa atscam runacuna quichquishga goriraycäyargan Jesusta shuyacur.
Tsaymannam Israel runacunapa autoridänin Jairo jutiyog runa chärirgan. Payga cargan Tayta Diosman mañacur goricäyangancunachö mandacogmi. Tsay runam Jesuspa ñöpanman gonguricuycur rugacur nirgan:
“Taytay, warmi tsurïchä wanuycanna. Acu jinallachö wayïman aywayculläshun maquillayquiwan yataycunayquipä. Tsayga allircur cawangam” nir.
Tsaynam Jairuwan Jesus aywaraycäyargan wayinman. Y atsca runacunam gepanta aywayargan.
Tsay runacunachömi juc warmi aywargan chunca ishcay (12) watana yawar apaywan geshyagyashga.
Tsay warmega atscag jampicogcunachö jampicurninpis manam allirgantsu. Tsaynöpam imaycancunatapis pasaypa ranticurna ushargan. Payga jampicur allïnanpa rantin masmi antsargan.
Tsay warmega geshyagyashga runacunata Jesus allïtsinganta musyarmi runacunapa rurinllapa yaycuycur Jesuspa röpanta yataycurgan.
Tsay warmega yarpänä shongunllachö: “Jesuspa röpallantapis yataycurga allisquishämi” nir.
Tsay yarpangannö Jesuspa röpanta gepallanpa yataycuptinmi yawar aywaynin pärasquirgan. Y jinallanchömi quiquin warmipis allisquingantaga mayasquirgan.
Tsay warmi allinganta tantiyasquirnam gepanchö runacunaman ticraycur Jesus tapurgan: “¿Pitä yataycamushga röpäta?” nir.
Tsaynam discïpuluncuna niyargan: “Tayta Jesus, ¡cay atsca runachöga imanöparächi musyashwan röpayquita pï yatamungantapis! ¿Imanirtä gamga tapucunqui: ‘¿Pitä röpäta yatamushga?’ nirnin?”
Tsaynö niyaptinnam Jesus llapanta ricapargan: “Mä ¿pishi yatamashga?” nir.
Tsaynam warmi allisquinganta tantiyar mantsariywan tsuctsucyarrä Jesuspa ñöpanman gonguricuycurgan caynö nir: “Señor Jesus, nogallämi röpayquita yataycallämurgö”.
Tsaynö niptinnam Jesus nirgan: “Hïja, nogaman yäracamurmi tsay geshyayquipita allirguyqui. Cananga cushishgana cuticuy” nir.
Jesus tsaynö parlapaycaptinmi Jairupa willacognincuna chaycur caynö niyargan: “Tayta Jairo, tsuriquega wanushganam. ¿Imapänatä Jesustapis wayiquiman pushanqui?” nir.
Tsaynö negta wiyaycurnam Jesus Jairuta ricarcur nirgan: “Ama llaquicuytsu. Nogallaman yäracamuyga” nir.
Tsaynam Jairupa wayinman Jesus aywargan discïpuluncuna Pedruta, Santiaguta, y Juanta pusharcur. Waquincuna aywayänantaga manam munargantsu.
Jairupa wayinman chaycur rasunpapis tarisquiyargan wamra wanushgana caycagtam y tsaychö atsca runacuna pasaypa wagaycäyagtam.
Tsaynam Jesus caynö nirgan: “¿Imatatä tsayläya wagayanqui? Cay wamra wanushga caycarpis punuycagnöllam riccharcamunga” nir.
Tsaynö niptin Jesustaga runacuna asipäyarganmi. Tsaynam llapan runacunata wagtaman gargascamur Jesus quimsan discïpuluncunawan y wamrapa papäninwan mamanwan yaycuyargan aya sutaraycanganman.
Tsaychönam Jesus wamrata maquinpita tsarircur caynö nirgan: “Wamra, sharcamuy” nirnin.
Tsaynö niptin wamraga jinan öram sharcarcamur purir gallaycurgan. Tsay wamraga cargan chunca ishcay (12) watayogmi. Jesus cawarircatsimuptin wamrapaga papänincuna pasaypa espantacurmi cushicuyargan.
Tsaypitanam paycunata Jesus nirgan: “Cay wamrata cawatsimungäta pitapis willacuycäyanquimantä” nir. Nisquirnam nirgan wamrata micunan garayänanpä.

footnotes.text: Legion ninanga “atsca waranga o miles” ninanmi.
Arameu idiömachö Jesus parlarmi nirgan: “Talita cum” nir. Tsay ninanga “wamra, sharcamuy” ninanmi.
